question: Who agreed to acquire Taalas in August 2026?

hits.title: AMD buys Taalas, the startup etching AI models into silicon.
hits.snippet: Taalas says its hardware can generate more tokens per second per user than Nvidia's H200 and B200 accelerators, and outpaces specialist inference hardware from Groq, SambaNova, and Cerebras, while consuming one tenth of the power.

hits.title: AMD just bought a 17,000 token/sec chip. It runs one model.
hits.snippet: CNX Software logged a peak of about 17,000 tokens/s, with 15,000 to 16,000 on typical queries, and Taalas' own comparison against Cerebras also claimed 20x lower build cost and 10x lower power.

hits.title: AMD acquires Taalas to advance compute solutions for rapidly growing AI inference market.
hits.snippet: SANTA CLARA, Calif., Aug. 6, 2026 - AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced it has reached a definitive agreement to acquire Taalas, a pioneer in specialized AI inference silicon.

hits.title: Taalas raises $169 mln to push model-specific AI inference chips
hits.snippet: February 25, 2026 /SemiMedia/ - Toronto-based chip startup Taalas said it has raised $169 million in new funding and is developing a custom processor designed to run artificial intelligence inference workloads faster and at lower cost than conventional approaches.

hits.title: Record performance: 17,000 tokens per second with a new solution from startup Taalas
hits.snippet: Canadian startup Taalas recently announced its first product, the HC1 chip with Llama 3.1 8B.

hits.title: Taalas raises $169M in funding to develop model-specific AI chips
hits.snippet: Taalas Inc., a startup that develops chips optimized to run specific artificial intelligence models, has raised $169 million in funding.

hits.title: AI-to-silicon startup Taalas raises $50m in two rounds
hits.snippet: Now, with its new funding and out of stealth mode, Taalas plans to unveil its first LLM chip in the third quarter of 2024, and commercially available in Q1 2025.

hits.title: Taalas Raises USD 50M Funding
hits.snippet: Founded by Ljubisa Bajic, Drago Ignjatovic, and Lejla Bajic, Taalas is developing an automated flow for implementing all types of deep learning models (Transformers, SSMs, Diffusers, MoEs, etc.) in silicon.

hits.title: Tenstorrent founder reveals new AI chip startup Taalas with $50 million in funding
hits.snippet: Toronto-based artificial intelligence (AI) chip development startup Taalas has launched out of stealth with $50 million in funding.

ar.note: Ranks 1-3 identify AMD as acquirer of Taalas; rank 3 also gives Aug 2026 date. Others are earlier funding news.
